note: Single source of truth for visual identity. The Creative Engine, lead-magnet assets, and all generated creatives MUST read tokens from this file. Do not hardcode hex values anywhere else. v2.0 (D-14 ruling, Cena 2026-07-05): rewritten to describe what the live Revarity properties ACTUALLY ship — the deep-green/ivory/gold family from analyzethedeal.com (incl. its dark theme) + Inter body, verified against production CSS of revarity.com, analyzethedeal.com, and shop.revarity.com. The v1.0 ink/cream/#c9a961 + Manrope/JetBrains identity matched none of them. Creative claim/compliance rules folded in from the previously-richer vendored copy so nothing regresses.

display.role: Headlines, hero copy, emphasis. Serif. Editorial, premium. (The one face v1.0 got right — ATD's funnel headlines ship in it.)
display.italic_use: Gold-colored italic is the signature emphasis treatment for the single most important word in a headline.

ui.role: Body, UI, paragraphs, buttons, labels, numbers. Sans-serif. The body face on every live Revarity property.

typography.max_faces: TWO typefaces total (D-16 design charter). The v1.0 JetBrains Mono label face is retired; labels/eyebrows use Inter uppercase with wide tracking; code/data surfaces use the system monospace stack (not a loaded webfont).

do: Deep green (#0c2620) is the primary brand color across the family; gold is the accent, never the base.
Gold-on-dark and ink-on-ivory are the two primary contrast pairings.
Use generous negative space. Premium, not crowded.
One static radial gold glow on dark backgrounds for atmosphere — no animated decoration (D-16).
Italic Fraunces in gold for the single most important word in a headline.
Real photography of furnished units beats AI-rendered interiors where available.
State the offer honestly: free to explore sourced deals + the community; pay nothing until you accept a deal; the client funds their own unit at cost; management is billed after setup.
dont: No purple gradients, no generic SaaS-blue, no stock-photo gloss.
No fonts outside the two above.

No AI-generated talking-head / fake-testimonial UGC video (D-03). On-camera people may appear ONLY as aspirational lifestyle b-roll (not speaking to camera, not posing as a client); the selling message is carried by voiceover.

No guaranteed-returns / guaranteed-income / risk-free / 'can't lose' language. No performance, occupancy, or profit guarantees — results vary; the client assumes financial responsibility (Agreement §16).
Don't say 'no upfront cost' unqualified — it must read as no program / entry / franchise / 'door' fee; the client still funds their own unit at cost.
Costs are passed AT COST with no inflated markups — never imply hidden markups or show itemized markup.

meta_feed_portrait.use: FB/IG feed portrait 4:5 — max feed real estate, strong for feed video + static

before_after_split.use: Before/after unit transformation, vertical or horizontal split
